read.summary:
I read all 10 files of GitHub Copilot's prototype on origin/main (d2d6cad, which merges Copilot PR #1, commit 6d79f00). I only used git ls-tree and git show; nothing in /home/claude/hushloom was changed and its git status is clean. To check behaviour, I copied the files into the scratchpad and ran them there: the tests, the server probed with curl, and Playwright Chromium.

It is a front-end-only mock. It has 8 hard-coded templates with CSS-gradient "art" and no real media. Filtering, search, favorites, recently viewed and prompt/frame/motion edits all run in the browser and are saved to localStorage. A 53-line Node server serves an allowlist of 4 files from 127.0.0.1:4173. There is no API, database, auth, generation, upload or credits, and the docs say so honestly.

Where the docs overstate is the QA in docs/engineering.md L86. Running the app shows that a closed template dialog stays on screen and blocks clicks on the gallery. Recently viewed shows items in catalog order rather than most recent first, and it cannot be reached on mobile. The 5 tests cover only the pure filter function.

Full evidence, with file and line numbers and per-claim verdicts for all three docs, is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude-hushloom/ef68adc1-eb6d-56e0-b7e4-cbc2303fcdd6/scratchpad/ctx/copilot-main.md. Screenshots are in scratchpad/shots/ and probe scripts in scratchpad/scripts/.
claims: origin/main has 10 files totalling 67,948 bytes: README.md 713, docs/engineering.md 8491, docs/playbox-2-vision.md 6587, index.html 7746, package.json 274, server.mjs 2056, src/app.js 10812, src/catalog.js 4271, styles.css 25499, test/catalog.test.js 1589. There are no images, video, lockfile, CI config or .env.

The catalog is a hard-coded array of 8 templates (4 Images, 4 Videos) in src/catalog.js L1-106. The artwork is CSS gradients (styles.css L154-185), and the Video templates contain no video, only a duration label (app.js L102-104).

index.html renders a skip link, a top bar (Explore and Collection nav, search with a / shortcut, a decorative avatar), a welcome hero, a sidebar with 6 category buttons, a gallery with a mobile chip strip (which has no Recently viewed chip, L76-80), a footer, a template <dialog> (prompt textarea, frame select, motion range, Start creating button) and a toast.

app.js makes no network calls; the only storage access is localStorage at L27 and L36, using keys playbox.favorites.v1, playbox.recentlyViewed.v1 and playbox.edits.v1. In the browser run, the only requests were the 4 local assets and Google Fonts.
'Start creating' (app.js L257-261) only shows a notice that generation is not connected; no job is submitted.

server.mjs accepts GET and HEAD only (any other method gets 405, L16-19). It decodes the path (malformed escapes get 400, L21-27), maps / to index.html and serves only the 4 allowlisted files (L7, L28-32); everything else, including /explore, /api/templates and /server.mjs, gets 404. It binds 127.0.0.1 on PORT or 4173 (L50-53).

The server has no persistence, auth, request-body validation or API routes. It reads files from disk on every request with no caching. The CSP, nosniff and Referrer-Policy headers are set only on 200 responses (L37-42), not on 404, 400 or 405.
package.json has scripts start (node server.mjs) and test (node --test), type module, no dependencies and no engines field, so the README's 'Node 18 or newer' is not enforced.

test/catalog.test.js has 5 node:test tests, all of the pure catalog module only: both media categories exist and every template has an id and prompt; category filters return only matching items; search is case-insensitive and trims whitespace; Saved and Recently viewed match the given ids; search combines with category. Reproduced: 5 pass, 0 fail on Node 22.22.0.

Confirmed defect: styles.css L191 gives .template-dialog display:grid, which overrides the browser's rule that hides a closed dialog, so after Escape or the close button, dialog.open is false but the panel stays fixed on screen and intercepts clicks on cards (seen at 1280px and 390px wide).

Confirmed defect: the Recently viewed shelf shows catalog order, not most-recent-first (stored [slow-bloom, moon-motel, cloud-nine] is shown as Moon Motel, Cloud Nine, Slow Bloom), because filterTemplates keeps catalog order (catalog.js L117-122).
Confirmed defect: at widths up to 620px the sidebar is hidden (styles.css L257) and the chip strip has no Recently viewed chip, so Recently viewed and Clear history cannot be reached on mobile.

Confirmed defect: a malformed stored value (for example favorites saved as {"a":1}) throws 'object is not iterable' and the app renders 0 cards, because readStorage (app.js L25-32) does not check the shape of what it reads.
'For you' is not personalized: it returns the same 8 templates as 'All templates' (catalog.js L121). Search does not look at prompt text.
Doc claim not backed: engineering.md L86 says a headless Chromium check verified the template-details flow, but no such script is committed and the dialog-close defect reproduces.
Doc claim partly backed: engineering.md L31 says CSS variables centralize spacing, but --space-1 to --space-12 and --surface-raised are defined (styles.css L7, L17-23) and never used.

Doc claim partly backed: the vision doc L49 says the grid goes down to 'one/two' columns, but the computed layout is 4 columns at 1500px, 3 at 1280px and 2 at every width from 360px to 900px, with no single-column layout. The design-token values in the vision doc L41-47 match styles.css exactly.

The docs' scope disclaimers are accurate: no DB, auth, AI, queue, credits, uploads or deployment (engineering.md L7, L87-89; README L14), and the architecture and API sections are labelled as not implemented (engineering.md L35, L45).

routes: Server: PORT=4590 node server.mjs, run from scratchpad/copilot-main. It reads process.env.PORT (default 4173) and binds 127.0.0.1. Log line: 'Playbox preview available at http://127.0.0.1:4590'. It has no router: GET/HEAD of 4 allowlisted files, with / mapped to index.html.
GET /index.html?x=1 -> 200 (query ignored); GET /src/../index.html (--path-as-is) -> 200; GET /src%2fapp.js -> 200 (decoded before the allowlist check)
HEAD /styles.css -> 200 with the same headers, 0 B body
200 responses carry X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, the CSP (default-src 'self'; ... frame-ancestors 'none') and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
GET /%E0%A4%A (malformed escape) -> 400, no Content-Type, body 'Bad request' (11 B)
POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/OPTIONS / -> 405, empty body, Allow: GET, HEAD; POST /api/templates with a JSON body -> 405 (body never read)
404/405/400 responses carry none of the security headers (only Date, Connection, Keep-Alive, Transfer-Encoding, plus Content-Type on 404 and Allow on 405)
Server stopped with kill 1054 after checking that /proc/1054/cwd was the scratch export; afterwards curl to :4590 returned exit 7 (connection refused)
interactions: Console: no console messages and no page errors at 390, 820 or 1440, nor during any interaction run. Load requests (all 200, 0 failed): /, /styles.css, /src/app.js, /src/catalog.js, plus fonts.googleapis.com css2 and 2 fonts.gstatic.com woff2. The only page error came from the deliberate corrupt-storage test.
WORKS: side-nav Images/Videos (4 cards each, headings change), Recently viewed (empty state plus Clear history), Saved, For you (8).
WORKS BUT HOLLOW: 'All templates' shows the same 8 cards in the same order as 'For you'; only the hash and highlight change.
WORKS at 390: chips For you/All/Images/Videos/Saved (8/8/4/4/0). There is no Recently viewed chip and the side nav is display:none, so Recently viewed and Clear history cannot be reached at 390.

WORKS on desktop and tablet: search ('/' focuses it; moon->1, 'MOON '->1, playbox->8 via creator, video->4, terrarium->0 because prompts are not searched; Escape clears and blurs; search stays inside the current category).

BROKEN (NEW) at 390: search cannot be reached. styles.css L244 sets the input to display:none and only :focus-within (L245-246) shows it again, but nothing inside the box can take focus. Mouse click and touch tap on the icon leave activeElement=BODY; typing 'moon' leaves value ''; '/' does nothing; #search.focus() fails; #search is not in the first 40 Tab stops.

WORKS: favorite heart (toast 'Saved to your collection.', count +1, localStorage); un-favorite inside Saved removes the card; top-nav Collection (#collection, hero hidden) and Explore; empty-state 'Back to exploring'; skip link (first Tab stop, Enter -> #main).

DOES NOTHING: avatar 'Y' (focus only, matching its 'sign-in not available' label); card media tag; the decorative ↗ quick-arrow; welcome note; sidebar note. The brand 'playbox.' link does nothing when the hash is already #explore (clicked from Saved, it stayed on Saved).

WORKS: card title/art opens the dialog with correct fields; the details toggle; prompt/frame/motion edits are saved to playbox.edits.v1 and restored after reload (motion label Gentle->Expressive); Start creating only shows the 'not connected' notice and makes 0 network requests; Clear history (toast, 0 cards, recents [] but edits kept).

BROKEN (confirmed at all 3 sizes): ×, Escape and backdrop click set dialog.open=false but the panel stays display:grid, position:fixed on screen (1440 rect [275,106,890,688]; 820 [16,359,788,462]; 390 [12,78,366,687]). elementFromPoint at a card returns #dialog-art or label.field-label, and Playwright card clicks time out with 'dialog subtree intercepts pointer events'.

BROKEN (NEW, same cause styles.css L191): a never-opened, empty dialog shell rises into the viewport on short pages: 1440 Recently viewed empty y=823, Saved with 2 cards y=848, 390 Saved empty y=778. The × and 'Playbox picks ·' can be seen under the footer.
BROKEN (confirmed): Recently viewed shelf. Stored [after-hours, petal-study, slow-bloom, cloud-nine, moon-motel]; shown Moon Motel, Cloud Nine, After Hours, Petal Study, Slow Bloom (catalog order).
BROKEN (confirmed): favorites set to {"a":1} -> 0 cards, empty result count, TypeError 'object is not iterable'.
run.summary:
Ran Copilot's origin/main (d2d6cad) in a fresh `git archive` export at /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude-hushloom/ef68adc1-eb6d-56e0-b7e4-cbc2303fcdd6/scratchpad/copilot-main. Nothing in /home/claude/hushloom was changed, and its git status was still empty afterwards.

- **Install and tests:** package.json has no dependencies, so `npm install` was skipped and nothing was installed. `npm test` passed 5 of 5 on Node 22.22.0.
- **Server:** ran on PORT=4590 and was stopped at the end; the port then refused connections.
  - Only `/` and the 4 allowlisted files return 200.
  - Everything else returns 404, except other methods (405) and a malformed escape (400).
  - The security headers appear only on 200 responses.
- **Browser run:** Playwright with headless Chromium 141 at 390, 820 and 1440 wide. There were no console errors, and no network requests apart from local assets and Google Fonts.

Two new defects that reading the code had missed:
- **Search can't be reached at phone width.** At 620px and below the search input is hidden (styles.css L244) and only shown when the search box has focus (L245-246). Nothing in the box can take focus, so a tap, a click, `/` and `.focus()` all fail.
- **An empty dialog shell shows on short pages.** A dialog that has never been opened rises into view at the bottom of the viewport when the gallery is short. It has the same cause as the known close bug (`display: grid` at styles.css L191).

Confirmed again by running it:
- A closed dialog stays on screen and blocks clicks on the cards, at all 3 sizes.
- Recently viewed shows items in catalog order, not most recent first.
- Recently viewed and Clear history can't be reached on mobile.
- A corrupt localStorage value blanks the grid.
- 'All templates' is identical to 'For you'.

Elements that do nothing: the avatar, the decorative ↗ arrow, the media tag, and the brand link when already on #explore.

I appended section "8. Observed by running it", with exact commands and outputs, to /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude-hushloom/ef68adc1-eb6d-56e0-b7e4-cbc2303fcdd6/scratchpad/ctx/copilot-main.md. Screenshots and pw-run.log are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude-hushloom/ef68adc1-eb6d-56e0-b7e4-cbc2303fcdd6/scratchpad/ctx/copilot-shots/. The probe scripts are pw-run.cjs and pw-extra.cjs in the scratch export.
